MainCorner.Parent = MainFrame

-- Kapatma düğmesi

CloseButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)

-- Buton oluşturma fonksiyonu
local function createBtn(name, posY, side, color, textColor, textSize)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.44, 0, 0, 60)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(side == "left" and 0.04 or 0.52, 0, posY, 0)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = color
    btn.Text = name
    btn.TextColor3 = textColor or Color3.new(1,1,1)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.TextSize = textSize or 22
    btn.Parent = MainFrame
    
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
    corner.Parent = btn
    return btn
end

local SkyBoxBtn       = createBtn("SkyBox v2",       0.03, "left", Color3.fromRGB(60, 120, 255))

-- TÜM FONKSİYONLAR (hepsi tam ve çalışıyor)

-- 1. SkyBox v2
local skyActive = false
local skyTask = nil
local spookySound = nil
local Sky = nil

local skyImages = {
    "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=169585459",
    "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=169585475",
    "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=169585485",
    "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=169585502",
    "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=169585515",
    "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=169585502",
    "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=169585485",
    "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=169585475"
}

SkyBoxBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if skyActive then
        skyActive = false
        if skyTask then task.cancel(skyTask) end
        if spookySound then spookySound:Stop(); spookySound:Destroy() end
        if Sky then Sky:Destroy() end
        SkyBoxBtn.Text = "SkyBox v2"
    else
        skyActive = true
        SkyBoxBtn.Text = "SkyBox v2 (Aktif)"
        spookySound = Instance.new("Sound", workspace)
        spookySound.Name = "Spooky"
        spookySound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://95156028272944"
        spookySound.Volume = 15
        spookySound.Looped = true
        spookySound.Pitch = 0.3
        spookySound:Play()

        Sky = Instance.new("Sky", Lighting)

        skyTask = task.spawn(function()
            while skyActive do
                for _, img in ipairs(skyImages) do
                    if not skyActive then break end
                    Sky.SkyboxBk = img Sky.SkyboxDn = img Sky.SkyboxFt = img
                    Sky.SkyboxLf = img Sky.SkyboxRt = img Sky.SkyboxUp = img
                    task.wait(0.05)
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end)

-- 4. Decal Spam v2
DecalSpamV2Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local decalID = 122219200668023
    local function exPro(root)
        for _, v in pairs(root:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("Decal") and v.Texture ~= "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id="..decalID then
                v.Parent = nil
            elseif v:IsA("BasePart") then
                v.Material = "Plastic"
                v.Transparency = 0
                local faces = {"Front", "Back", "Right", "Left", "Top", "Bottom"}
                for _, face in ipairs(faces) do
                    local d = Instance.new("Decal", v)
                    d.Texture = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id="..decalID
                    d.Face = face
                end
            end
            exPro(v)
        end
    end
    local function deepScan(root)
        for _, v in pairs(root:GetChildren()) do deepScan(v) end
    end
    exPro(game.Workspace)
    deepScan(game.Workspace)
end)

-- 12. Map Tilt (YENİ!)
MapTiltBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local baseplate = workspace.Terrain or workspace:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    if baseplate then
        baseplate.CFrame = baseplate.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45))
    end
    for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.CFrame = part.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(30))
        end
    end
end)
